decisions.statement: What an audit learned is sent to the pages service.
The tree an audit holds is read and never written.
A row is sent as one line, and the append puts the newline on.
A caller may put a recorder of its own in place of the pages service.
A row the pages refused answers as no file part rather than throwing.
The commit a row answers for is read from the tree the audit holds.
Nothing here reads a verdict back.

definition: what an audit learned, sent to the pages service rather than into the tree it holds
